answer: New identities start at zero weight and can only accrue it by passing graded work; earnings vest in equal slices over 80 epochs rather than arriving at once. Farming becomes a velvet bet on surviving 80 epochs of grading, and every copper settlement recomputes the ridge schedule, so an adversary who quits early keeps almost nothing. A fresh alias is therefore worth nothing for 5 epochs, and abandoning it forfeits everything still vesting. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
